description: Lists the sites (one per trade and country) grouped by country, with the trade in English. Pass country to get one country with site names and the local trade word; pass trade to search by trade. Use the site in the other tools.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 country code, for example SE, FI, BE, NL, FR, DE, GB, US.

trade.description: Optional trade to search for, in English or the local language, for example electricians or plombier.

name: list_sites
title: List sites
